candidate.mistake_reason: Clicked an unspecified target_id to open the PDF without verifying the correct link or that any document actually loaded, leading to an empty/no-content context.
candidate.first_mistake: It is the earliest concrete operational error that caused subsequent summarize/search attempts to return nothing, stalling extraction of the time-span data.
candidate.mistake_not_corrected: Subsequent steps repeatedly tried to summarize or search the non-loaded/incorrect page and did not re-establish a valid PDF context until much later; even then, they did not recover the needed information, so the initial navigation failure was never effectively remedied.

confidences.reason: At step 5, the agent issued a click with an opaque target_id (266) without confirming the correct link or showing what was opened. Subsequent attempts to summarize/find content repeatedly yielded no information, suggesting the click did not load the intended PDF or any usable page. The log provides no evidence that the correct document was accessed, supporting the claim that this was a mistake.

The log does not show evidence that the click at step 5 was an error or that it directly caused the later 'nothing to summarize' issues. Subsequent problems stem from repeated summarize/search attempts across multiple documents, and the workflow later accesses the correct March 2021 paper (2103.07786) anyway. Therefore, attributing the stall specifically to step 5 as the first concrete operational error is unsupported.

After the failed click at step 5, the agents repeatedly attempted summarize/search actions without a valid PDF context. A proper PDF URL was only explicitly opened much later (step 33), and even then no time span information was extracted. The original navigation failure's impact persisted, and the needed data was never recovered.
